_comment: URL shortener domains. A hit yields URL_SHORTENER at severity WARN (design.md §3.4).
WARN, not CRITICAL, and this is deliberate. Indian banks and delivery services use
shorteners constantly in genuine SMS — a 160-character limit and a long tracking URL
leave no choice. `implementation.md` Phase 2 names 'genuine-with-shortener' as one of the
four hardest labelling boundaries for exactly this reason. Treating a shortener as
damning would fail the 15 genuine-bank-SMS fixtures that Phase 1 requires to pass with
What a shortener actually means is that the offline URL analyzer cannot see the
destination: no domain age, no typosquat check, no homograph check. It is a loss of
evidence, and the explanation template says so rather than calling it dangerous.
`brand_operated` lists shorteners a known brand runs itself; these are excluded from the
WARN, since flagging amzn.to on a genuine Amazon delivery SMS is a false positive with no
upside. The list is short on purpose — an entry here suppresses a warning, so it must be
verified against genuine observed SMS rather than guessed at. Grow it in Phase 2 from the
hard-negative corpus, where the genuine messages that use these will actually appear.
